newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P gives GMAC Australia notes A-minus rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P gives GMAC Australia notes A-minus rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it assigned an "A minus" long-term rating to the medium term note programme of General Motors Acceptance Corp Australia, a unit of General Motors Corp.
S&P said it assigned the rating on the basis of a guarantee provided by GMAC in the United States.

The ratings on guaranteed debt issued by GMAC Australia and GMAC Australia (Finance) were also affirmed, reflecting the A-minus long term and A2 short term ratings assigned to the U.S. parent, GMAC, the finance arm of General Motors Corp.
